# Tell screen-reader users when an entry is saved or cancelled

## What & Why
Answer and opportunity dialogs now return keyboard focus to their launch controls, but users who rely on assistive technology still do not receive a clear announcement that the dialog action completed. A concise live-region message would make save and cancel outcomes easier to understand.

## Done looks like
- Saving an answer or opportunity announces a clear success message.
- Cancelling a form announces that no changes were saved.
- The message is exposed through an accessible live region without disrupting focus restoration.
